wiki.title: Ya Liu
wiki.extract: Guangya Liu (born 1980–1981; Chinese: 刘广亚) is an American politician currently serving as a member of the North Carolina House of Representatives, representing the 21st district (including portions of western Wake County) since 2023. A Democrat, Liu previously served on the Cary Town Council from 2019 to 2023. During her term, Liu was investigated and later suspended for 2 years for mismanagement of financial trust accounts by the North Carolina Bar. The suspension was stayed for two years for monitoring.
